name: CCVI-Bench-12
description: Download and reconstruction. The original release archive is supplied as 87 small standard ZIP transport parts, each less than 2.1 MB. Download all files named CCVI-Bench-12-v1.1.0.part01-of-87.zip through CCVI-Bench-12-v1.1.0.part87-of-87.zip, together with REASSEMBLE_CCVI.py, PARTS_MANIFEST.json, README_REASSEMBLE.txt and SHA256SUMS.txt. Run python3 REASSEMBLE_CCVI.py in that folder; the script reads the ZIP parts directly, verifies every part and reconstructs CCVI-Bench-12-v1.1.0.zip (173,275,484 bytes; SHA-256 195d06cb225c6f5a13915134637a5baf815ccf1a69aa035ff851775592704a34; MD5 c58ef2b531a5730660a10236896c56e9). Extract the reconstructed archive normally. All 518 scientific release files, including their original manifest, are preserved byte for byte. This changes transport packaging only; no scientific file, result or version was changed. CCVI-Bench-12 is an open benchmark for computed field enhancement on copper-chromium (CuCr) vacuum interrupter contact surfaces. It accompanies the paper Benchmarking a convolutional surrogate against surface-texture descriptors for computed field enhancement on CuCr vacuum interrupter contacts (I. H. Hasan, E. Dong, A. A. AL-Bakhrani, L. Zhang, L. Wang, Y. Wang, R. Yao and H. Cui; submitted to Journal of Physics D: Applied Physics).
